attribution_window.description: Time period used to attribute conversions based on clicks.

profiles.description: Specific User Profile IDs to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificProfiles`.

region.description: The region used by the Amazon Ads profile.

sync_mode.description: Option to select connector should sync all profiles or specific profiles.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Amazon Ads client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Amazon Ads client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
